sources.title: Adisyonist AI - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Adisyonist AI Adisyonist builds AI-powered solutions for restaurant and point-of-sale (POS) software. We develop compact, multilingual language models that let restaurant staff manage orders, tables, reservations, inventory, and sales analytics through natural conversation.

sources.snippet: What is Adisyonist? Adisyonist is a modern QR menu and digital ordering software designed for restaurants, cafes, and food & beverage establishments. Your customers can easily view your menu and place their orders by scanning the QR code on their tables.
